auth.login.marketing.body: Sign in to access your AI video resumes, resume scoring history, job matches, and career dashboard — all in one place.
auth.login.faq.methodsQ: What sign-in methods does hired.video support?
auth.login.faq.methodsA: hired.video supports sign-in via Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, Microsoft, email/password, and passwordless magic links. All methods are free.
auth.login.faq.freeA: Yes. hired.video is free to start with AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job matching, and 50K AI tokens per month. The Pro plan ($9.95/mo) unlocks unlimited features.
auth.login.faq.resetQ: How do I reset my password?
auth.login.faq.resetA: Click 'Forgot your password?' on the login page, enter your email, and you'll receive a reset link. You can also use passwordless magic link sign-in as an alternative.

auth.signup.faq.freeQ: Is hired.video free to sign up?
auth.signup.faq.freeA: Yes. hired.video is completely free to start. You get AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job matching (5/month), 50K AI tokens/month, and access to all 10+ career tools. No credit card required.
auth.signup.faq.setupQ: How long does it take to set up?
auth.signup.faq.setupA: Under 2 minutes. Sign up with Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, or email, choose your role (Job Seeker, Recruiter, or Employer), and you're in. You can create your first AI video resume in 60 seconds.
auth.signup.faq.methodsA: hired.video supports sign-up via Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, Microsoft, or email/password. All methods are free and give you immediate access to the platform.
auth.signup.faq.planQ: What's included in the free plan?
auth.signup.faq.planA: The free plan includes: 1 published AI video resume, ATS-friendly resume builder, Chrome extension for job tracking, AI tools (resume scorer, optimizer, salary calculator, and more), career dashboard, job matching, and unlimited networking. Pro ($9.95/mo) adds unlimited videos, voice cloning, 1080p export, and 1M AI tokens/month.
